rows.answer:
To make up attendance hours at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year, you have the following options:

- Attend AM or PM Study Halls (these count as double hours)

To report a student absence at Vista Ridge High School, you can:

rows.question: What is the student check-out policy?
rows.answer:
Here is the student check-out policy at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year:

- Parents/guardians must come to the office in person, provide a photo ID, and check their student out.
- Phone calls for leaving early are NOT accepted.
- Students MUST sign in/out at the Attendance Window when they leave or return to campus.
- Please arrive at least 20 minutes BEFORE you need your student to be released due to the high volume of requests.
- In-person early check-outs after 2:45 pm will not be granted. After 2:45 pm, please wait for your student to be dismissed at the normal time.
- On early release days, the cutoff pickup time is 11:45 am.
- If you send a note or email before 10:30 am (including the student's full legal name, ID#, grade, exact dismissal time, and reason for dismissal), your student can be checked out at any time later in the day.
- After your student's absence, you must provide a follow-up note or email documenting the reason for the absence to have it excused.
- Notes/emails are required for excusing the absence created by early check-outs.

For more details, you can visit: [How To Check Your Student Out Early](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhsattendance/student-sign-out).

Let me know if you have any other questions! Go Rangers!
sources: How To Check Your Student Out Early

rows.question: How do I register for AP tests?
rows.answer:
To register for AP tests at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year, you need to complete two main steps:

1. Register with College Board:
   - Create or log in to your College Board account at https://myap.collegeboard.org/login.
   - Enroll in each of your AP classes using the JOIN CODE provided by your teacher.
   - Indicate whether you plan to take the AP exam (“YES” or “NO”) for each class. The default is “YES,” but you must change it before the October 28, 2026 deadline if you do NOT want to take the exam.
   - Even if you do not plan to take the exam, you still need to register with MyAP.

2. Register and Pay with Total Registration:
   - Go to the [Total Registration Link](https://user.totalregistration.net/AP/441176).
   - Create an account or log in if you already have one.
   - Complete the registration and pay the exam fee ($85 per exam, or $27 per exam for students on free/reduced lunch).
   - Registration and payment are due by October 28, 2026. A late fee of $40 per exam applies if you register between October 29, 2026 and February 18, 2027.

**Important:** You must complete BOTH steps (College Board and Total Registration) for your exam to be ordered.

For more details and step-by-step instructions, visit the [AP Test Registration Info](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/ap-test-registration) page or the [VR Advanced Placement Website](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/advanced-placement/home).

If you need help or want to cancel an exam, contact the campus Dean of Instruction, Olga Angelo-Day.

Good luck with your AP exams, Ranger!

rows.question: What do seniors need to do before graduation?
rows.answer:
Here are the main things Vista Ridge High School seniors (Class of 2027) need to do before graduation, based on the available information:

- Order your Cap and Gown: This is required for graduation. Vista Ridge has partnered with Herff Jones for graduation items. The only required item is the Cap, Gown & Tassel Unit. Students will receive order packets and information at a senior meeting.

- Fill out the FAFSA: Completing the FAFSA is a graduation requirement. The FAFSA opens October 1st, and the priority deadline for most Texas universities is January 15th. Check each university for their specific deadlines.

- Attend Senior Meetings: These meetings provide important information about ordering graduation items and other senior activities.

- Clear All Obligations and Hours: All obligations and required hours must be cleared in order to pick up your cap and gown.

- Participate in Graduation Practice: There will be a graduation practice and a "Clap Out" immediately following.

- Complete the Name Pronunciation Form: In May, a form will be shared for you to fill out to ensure your name is pronounced correctly at graduation.

- Prepare for Senior Activities: These include the senior panoramic picture, prom, Senior SAIL, Senior Awards (invitation only), and Project Graduation. More information will be provided for some of these events.

- Google Account Transition: After graduation, your school Google account will be switched to an alumni account, which will remain active for one year. Download any files you want to keep.

- Participate in the Elementary Graduation Walks (optional): Seniors can return to their elementary school in cap and gown for a traditional walk.

For more details or if you have specific questions, please check the [Seniors 2027 page](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/seniors-2027) or contact the front office. Good luck with your senior year, Ranger!

rows.question: How do I access my STAAR scores?
rows.answer:
You can access your STAAR scores in two main ways:

**1. Through the Home Access Center (HAC):**
- Log into your LISD Home Access Center ([Home Access Center](https://www.leanderisd.org/homeaccess)).
- Click on the Grades icon at the top of the screen.
- Next to "Report Card" on the left, click on "Texas Test Scores."
- Your STAAR results will appear, or you may be directed to the Texas Student Portal.

**2. Through the Texas Assessment Parent Portal:**
- Go to [texasassessment.gov](https://www.texasassessment.gov).
- If you have your Student Unique Access Code (found on previous STAAR reports), enter it along with your child’s birthdate and legal first name, then click "Sign On."
- If you do not know the access code, click "How do I look up my access code?" and follow the instructions. You may need your student’s PEIMS ID (often the social security number) or the state-issued ID number.

For more detailed instructions, you can view these guides:
- [STAAR Results Information (STAAR Results: How to Access Your Child's Scores VRHS)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-FYpAMvoDN5DjGZD3ThvecRfWtAJCnss/view?usp=sharing)
- [Access Scores through the TEA Family Portal](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xFgr2XVW266HCu2g7wa5sUwFjWBj8LaCUbT4USgSkrU/edit?tab=t.0/)
- [Access Scores through the HAC](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gjw-eI37OPctz_CnqsSQbwPhIrcBWmGwaKzsj47wwyM/edit?tab=t.0)

If you have any trouble, please reach out to the front office or check the [Staff Directory](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/directory) for further assistance. Good luck, Ranger!
